description: Total time investment to make the recipe, accounting for time reclaimed by running steps in parallel.

dimension_definitions.prep_time: Minutes spent preparing ingredients before cooking begins (chopping, measuring, marinating setup)
dimension_definitions.cook_time: Minutes spent actively cooking (heat applied or other active transformation)
dimension_definitions.parallel_savings: Minutes reclaimed by running steps concurrently (e.g. chopping vegetables while water boils). Subtracted from the total.

scoring.method: effective_minutes = max(0, prep_time + cook_time - parallel_savings); mapped to a 1-10 mesh axis via buckets
